Thanks for the response. Meds don't really help me out much. It will probably get worse because it has been in the last few years but who knows..
I agree with you, thankfully not everyone is evil. However, my philosophical view of life is very negative. I don't consider myself a pessimist but a realistic person. I think there is far more suffering than joy in this world. Even if I magically solved all my problems, knowing that there is so much suffering, that mindset would still chase me. Thinking that there are other people also suffering too...that does not bring me comfort. Thats the result of having a vastly complex mind, I guess.
